scope: single-person behavioral sleep-midpoint proxy; not the production recommendation, physiology, or clinical benefit

time_contract.availability_assumption: sleep_end is treated as availability because observed_at is absent

prior.primary: fixed circular mean of first seven Train midpoints; proxy only, not enrollment input
prior.update_observations: causal midpoints after the seven prior-construction nights
prior.sensitivity: fixed circular mean of all Train targets, applied after candidate selection

train_only_hyperparameters.observation_variance: max(25, 0.5*mean consecutive squared differences of y)
train_only_hyperparameters.affine_observation_variance: max(25, mean squared identity residual y-x)
train_only_hyperparameters.y: shortest circular difference from fixed prior to target midpoint
train_only_hyperparameters.x: shortest circular difference from fixed prior to 14-day-half-life circular mean of causal prior midpoints
train_only_hyperparameters.circular_gaussian_guard: unsupported if any Train absolute y is at least 600 minutes or the Train y range is at least 720 minutes

current.prediction: prior plus M/(M+14) times shortest difference to the 14-day weighted circular history mean

alternatives.model: z~Normal(0,T), y|z~Normal(z,R); posterior mean from all eligible post-prior observations
scalar random-walk offset with process variance 0.001*R per elapsed calendar day
scalar random-walk offset with process variance 0.01*R per elapsed calendar day
scalar random-walk offset with process variance 0.1*R per elapsed calendar day
beta0+beta1*x with Normal prior centered at identity (0,1), recursively refit from eligible post-prior pairs

selection.metric: mean absolute circular sleep-midpoint error in minutes
selection.rule: lowest mean error; ties by declared candidate order
selection.test_access: write selection_lock.json before computing Test metrics

decision.production_promotion: prohibited from this one-person companion analysis alone
decision.interpretation: a favorable result is sensitivity evidence and must be corroborated by the separate cohort residual-layer comparison
decision.uncertainty: posterior variances are model diagnostics, not validated prediction intervals

reporting: locked Test current and selected only
paired mean and median gain and improved/equal/worsened nights
history, recency mass, gap strata, fitted coefficient or state diagnostics
no participant bootstrap or clinical confidence interval
